from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path("/workspace/skills/state-shopping")
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))

from domain_meta import DEFAULT_NOW, ENV_CLASS, ENV_DATA_CLASS, SAVE_MAP

ws = HERE / ".state"
ws.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
state_path = ws / "state.json"

env_data = ENV_DATA_CLASS.load(state_path)
env = ENV_CLASS(env_data, now=DEFAULT_NOW)

session_path = ws / "session.json"
if session_path.exists():
    sess = json.loads(session_path.read_text())
    for k, v in sess.items():
        setattr(env, k, v)

# Update mouse quantity to 2
params = {"customer_id": "user_fbab7801", "item_id": "CI-0010", "quantity": 2}
handler = env.tool_handlers["update_cart_item"]
update_result = handler(params)
print("UPDATE:", json.dumps(update_result))

# Save
rebuilt = ENV_DATA_CLASS(**{field: list(getattr(env, attr).values()) for field, attr in SAVE_MAP.items()})
rebuilt.save(state_path)
sess_out = {k: v for k, v in vars(env).items() if k.startswith("_")}
session_path.write_text(json.dumps(sess_out, indent=2))
print("SAVED")

# Verify
